== Biography ==

Jack Pumpkinhead is a farmer whose farm consists of a vast pumpkin field, where some of the pumpkins grow to enormous size. He designed his own house, which stands not far from the Scarecrow's mansion. Like the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and Tiktok, he has no need to sleep. He counts the Tin Woodman and the Scarecrow among his companions, and, together with the Tin Woodman and the Shaggy Man, he declared his intention to stand by Ozma.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Scarecrow]]''' — friend. Jack Pumpkinhead is named alongside the Scarecrow as one of the Wizard's old friends, and the two are described waiting out a night together at the Forbidden Fountain, suggesting a close bond.

'''[[Ozma]]''' — friend. Jack Pumpkinhead's declaration that he would stand by Ozma suggests loyalty toward her.

'''[[Nick Chopper]]''' — friend. His presence alongside the Tin Woodman during a visit to the tin castle suggests a friendly acquaintance.

'''[[Tiktok]]''' — friend. His overnight vigil beside the Forbidden Fountain alongside Tiktok suggests a companionable relationship.
